question: Who among the following wrote "The Bench"?
solution:
Correct Answer **Meghan Markle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The Bench" i**s a children's book written by **Meghan, The Duchess of Sussex.**
 
• It was published in **June 2021.**
 
• The book is illustrated by Christian Robinson and tells the story of a father-son relationship as seen through the eyes of a mother.
 
• **"Together: Our Community Cookbook" (2018): **Meghan wrote the foreword for this cookbook, which was created by a group of women affected by the Grenfell Tower fire in London.
 
• The book features recipes and stories from the Hubb Community Kitchen.
